description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'Thumbnail' and associated classes for rendering image thumbnails with cache size optimization. It includes utility classes for computing cache dimensions based on layout constraints and device pixel ratio. The file handles network images via 'cached_network_image' as well as local assets and files, providing a flexible and efficient thumbnail widget with placeholders and error handling.

classes.name: ThumbnailSize
classes.description: Represents the computed physical pixel dimensions for thumbnail cache decoding.

classes.name: ThumbnailProvider
classes.description: Utility class that converts layout size (logical pixels) and devicePixelRatio into cacheWidth and cacheHeight in physical pixels.

classes.name: Thumbnail
classes.description: A Flutter widget for rendering image thumbnails with size optimization, supporting network images, local files, assets, with placeholders and error widgets.

methods.name: computeFromConstraints
methods.description: Computes cache dimensions from layout constraints, device pixel ratio, and aspect ratio.

methods.name: _clampAndSnap
methods.description: Clamps a value within bounds and snaps it to nearest multiples for cache reuse.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the thumbnail widget, choosing the image source and applying size optimizations.

methods.name: _resolveProvider
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate ImageProvider with optional resize based on computed cache size.
